import { __decorate } from "tslib";
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, Input, ViewEncapsulation } from '@angular/core';
let OptionCheckboxIconComponent = class OptionCheckboxIconComponent {
    constructor() {
        this.state = 'off';
    }
    static { this.propDecorators = {
        state: [{ type: Input }]
    }; }
};
OptionCheckboxIconComponent = __decorate([
    Component({
        selector: 'orbit-option-checkbox-icon',
        standalone: true,
        imports: [CommonModule],
        template: `
    <svg
      *ngIf="state === 'on'"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <rect x="5" y="5" width="14" height="14" rx="2" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" fill="currentColor" />
      <path
        d="M8 12.5l2.5 2.5L16 9.5"
        stroke="var(--background-surface-container-2)"
        stroke-width="1.5"
        stroke-linecap="round"
        stroke-linejoin="round"
      />
    </svg>
    <svg
      *ngIf="state === 'partial'"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <rect x="5" y="5" width="14" height="14" rx="2" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" fill="currentColor" />
      <path d="M8 12h8" stroke="var(--background-surface-container-2)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
    </svg>
    <svg
      *ngIf="state === 'off'"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <rect x="5" y="5" width="14" height="14" rx="2" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" />
    </svg>
  `,
        encapsulation: ViewEncapsulation.None,
    })
], OptionCheckboxIconComponent);
export { OptionCheckboxIconComponent };
